verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q stacks and get hard-engaged pre-6; you win almost every extended trade and the 54.8% over 1660 games bears that out.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's entire kit is built around stacking Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the pull-in shockwave at 2 stacks, but Camille's longer basic attack range and W (Tactical Sweep) sustain let her punish his approach before he ever gets there. Outside of his all-in with R (All Out), K'Sante has no sustained damage answer to Camille's healing poke.

theirWindow.when: Q at 2 stacks, R off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can fire the shockwave to pull you in, then follow with R (All Out) to knock you through terrain and go all-in with boosted damage and healing. Back off or use E (Hookshot) to disengage the instant you see the second Q stack land.

yourWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With his dash-shield and stun-dash down, he has no way to close distance safely or escape. Walk up and land W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-edge slow and heal, then follow with Q (Precision Protocol) for the delayed bonus damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: sustained healing per proc out-trades his poke across the laning phase and scales your health for the Trinity Force burst combo

playing.title: Poke with W before he stacks Q
playing.detail: Land Tactical Sweep's outer edge early to slow and heal before he reaches 2 Q stacks; the healing component wins the HP race outright.

playing.title: Hold E for his shockwave
playing.detail: The instant his Q hits 2 stacks, be ready to use Hookshot to leap to a wall and reposition out of shockwave range rather than tanking the pull.

playing.title: All-in only with R up
playing.detail: Hextech Ultimatum anchors him in place and adds magic damage on your autos; never commit a full trade without it ready, since he outscales you in a raw stat-check.

playing.title: Track his W and E cooldowns
playing.detail: Path Maker and Footwork are his only engage and escape tools outside Q; once both are down (14/13/12/11/10s and 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s respectively), he's stuck and vulnerable.

playing.title: Respect the All Out knockback
playing.detail: His R launches you through terrain and starts his empowered state; if you get hit by it, immediately disengage rather than fighting into his buffed Q cooldown and healing.

playing.title: Delay Q recast for max damage
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's second hit does significantly more damage if you wait between the two attacks, so bait a trade, land the first hit, then recast after he commits.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (54.8% Camille win rate over 1660 head-to-head games); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read.
